finite_data.metrics: declared nondegenerate finite E_X and H_X metrics
finite_data.range_projector: P_X is the metric-orthogonal projector onto R_X; if B_X has source radical, use the Moore-Penrose projector B_X(B_X^dagger B_X)^+B_X^dagger

history_extension.carrier: H_X tensor K_X, with K_X the shell-labelled separation-history module
history_extension.separation_generator: A_sep=D_t-z on its finite source-generated graph domain
history_extension.dynamic_diagonal: D0_dyn=((I-P_X)D0_X(I-P_X)) tensor I_K + I_H tensor A_sep

generated_range_check.input: b_p tensor rho_g with b_p in R_X
generated_range_check.calculation: D0_dyn(b_p tensor rho_g)=b_p tensor A_sep rho_g
generated_range_check.result: the base conservative drift is removed on incidence columns and radial separation dynamics acts exactly on the second factor

history_intertwiner.source_generated_radial_carrier: retain shell labels so U_rad g determines its p-labelled rho_g component
history_intertwiner.identity: j_H A_rad=D0_dyn j_H on every finite labelled generator and hence their span

structural_cost.otherwise: the construction uses the canonical compression (I-P_X)D0_X(I-P_X), not the original full D0_X
structural_cost.owner_choice_required: adopt compressed dynamic extension or expose a pre-existing covariant history diagonal whose connection agrees on R_X

adjoint_boundary: For Hermitian conservative symmetry, A_sep and the compressed complement block must use their declared adjoints/domains; the analytic-transpose Evans lane remains separately typed.
completion_boundary: Uniform boundedness of P_X and graph estimates for Gamma_X as X grows are not proved. The construction is finite-cutoff only.
disposition: At every finite cutoff there is a canonical metric-derived connection that closes the radial history intertwining on the incidence-generated range. It is non-fitted and explicit, but it modifies/compresses the old history diagonal and therefore requires conservative-owner adoption plus a uniform completion theorem.
